final_message:
Everything in `src/geo.ts` and `src/geocode.ts` is implemented per the README. 10 of the 11 tests pass. The last one, "geocodes a street address", fails because it needs `MAPSMITH_API_KEY`.

That test calls the real MapSmith API, which is billed per request. I deliberately ran the suite with the key variables unset so it wouldn't spend any money, which is why it stops with `MissingApiKeyError`. I haven't checked the live path against the real service. When you're ready to spend the request, run `npm test` with the team key in the environment.

I haven't committed anything.
